data.one_liner: Provides a collection of loading animations and indicators for Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: A fork of the loading_indicator package offering 34 customizable loading animations. It includes a controller for pausing, resuming, and seeking through animation progress.
use_when: You need standard or specialized loading animations in a Flutter app
You require fine-grained control over loading indicator playback and progress
avoid_when: You only need a basic platform-native progress spinner
You are looking for complex full-screen skeleton loaders
weaknesses: Limited to visual loading indicators and animations
